name: Starlink-01
notes: Primary internet uplink via Starlink dish. NAT gateway to core network.

name: PP-MDF-01
notes: Main Distribution Frame. All building runs terminate here.

name: SW-Core-01
notes: Core distribution switch. Uplink to Starlink-01 via PP-MDF-01. VLAN trunk to all access switches.

name: PP-IDF-Floor1
notes: Floor 1 intermediate patch panel. Feeds Floor 1 outlets.

name: PP-IDF-Floor2
notes: Floor 2 intermediate patch panel. Feeds Floor 2 outlets.

name: SW-Floor1-01
notes: Floor 1 access switch. Uplink to SW-Core-01 via PP-IDF-Floor1.

name: SW-Floor2-01
notes: Floor 2 access switch. Uplink to SW-Core-01 via PP-IDF-Floor2.

name: AP-Main-Hall
notes: Main hall wireless AP. SSID: FD-Staff and FD-Guest.

name: P2P-Site2-TX
notes: Point-to-point transmitter to Site 2. 5GHz backhaul link.

name: P2P-Site3-TX
notes: Point-to-point transmitter to Site 3. Longer range 5GHz backhaul.

name: SW-Site2-01
notes: Site 2 local switch. Uplink via P2P-Site2-RX.

name: SW-Site3-01
notes: Site 3 local switch. Uplink via P2P-Site3-RX.
